Q: Can you help me justify my chosen statistical method in my methodology chapter?

We will assist you with justifications for the statistical methods selected for the task and act as your virtual assistants in the following aspects:
  • Academic rationale: Justification of the appropriateness of the adopted method to your specific research questions and type of data under analysis.
  • Citations: Support for the choice of method or procedure with related literature and relevant statistical references. https://careerforum.co.in/
  • Clarity: We will ensure that the justification is obviously clear, as well as the merits and demerits of that method in relation to the study.
Just tell us the method you’re using and the situation of your research, and then we customize our justification for reaffirming your needs. https://contenidos.cruzverde.cl/
